entries.title: Psalms 135:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD; Praise [Him], O you servants of the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 135:2
segments: You who stand in the house of the LORD, In the courts of the house of our God,

entries.title: Psalms 135:3
segments: Praise the LORD, for the LORD [is] good; Sing praises to His name, for [it is] pleasant.

entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His special treasure.

entries.title: Psalms 135:5
segments: ¶For I know that the LORD [is] great, And our Lord [is] above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 135:6
segments: Whatever the LORD pleases He does, In heaven and in earth, In the seas and in all deep places.

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain; He brings the wind out of His treasuries.

entries.title: Psalms 135:8
segments: He destroyed the firstborn of Egypt, Both of man and beast.

entries.title: Psalms 135:9
segments: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh and all his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:10
segments: He defeated many nations And slew mighty kings-

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan-

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: And gave their land [as] a heritage, A heritage to Israel His people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: Your name, O LORD, [endures] forever, Your fame, O LORD, throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
segments: For the LORD will judge His people, And He will have compassion on His servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:15
segments: ¶The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 135:16
segments: They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;

entries.title: Psalms 135:17
segments: They have ears, but they do not hear; Nor is there [any] breath in their mouths.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: Those who make them are like them; [So is] everyone who trusts in them.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel! Bless the LORD, O house of Aaron!

entries.title: Psalms 135:20
segments: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 135:21
segments: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, Who dwells in Jerusalem! Praise the LORD!
